rounds.q: How many days does a chicken egg take to hatch?
rounds.why: Duck and turkey eggs take a week longer, 28 days, and goose eggs take 30.
rounds.src: University of Maryland Extension, Hatching Eggs at Home FS-1114 (updated Aug 2023)
rounds.fun: Just 21 days from egg to chick. Ducks and turkeys need 28!

rounds.q: You lose a whole fingernail. About how many months until it grows back?
rounds.why: Skin doctors say 6 months or longer. A toenail is slower still: 12 to 18 months.
rounds.src: American Academy of Dermatology, Nail fungus treatment page (current guidance)
rounds.fun: 6 months or more for a fingernail, and 12 to 18 for a toenail. Patience!

rounds.q: How many years does Halley's Comet take to come back around?
rounds.why: It was last seen from Earth in 1986 and is due back in 2061.
rounds.fun: Last seen in 1986, back in 2061. Mark your calendar!

rounds.q: How many minutes does the Space Station take to circle Earth once?
rounds.why: That means the crew passes through 16 sunrises and 16 sunsets every 24 hours.
rounds.src: NASA, International Space Station Facts and Figures (current)
rounds.fun: One lap every 90 minutes means 16 sunrises a day. Good morning, again!

rounds.q: About how many thousand times does your heart beat in one day?
rounds.why: Over an average lifetime that adds up to more than 2.6 billion beats.
rounds.src: Cleveland Clinic, Facts About the Heart (current)
rounds.fun: About 100,000 beats today and more than 2.6 billion in a lifetime. Thanks, heart!
